class.name: NNAngleToVector3XZSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Scores and filters based on the angle on the xz-plane between the search space node direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]) compared to the given [member angle_to_direction_vector].
class.description: The [Vector3] XZ angle search criterion scores and filters [Node3D] candidates based on the signed angle on the XZ plane (in [code]-180..180[/code] degrees) from [member angle_to_direction_vector] to the node's forward direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]). When used for scoring, the angle is mapped linearly from [code]0.0[/code] at or below [member min_angle_degrees] to [code]1.0[/code] at or above [member max_angle_degrees], then passed through [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] if one is set.

members.member: Reference direction projected onto the XZ plane and compared against each candidate's projected forward direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]) as a signed angle in [code]-180..180[/code] degrees.

Maximum signed angle in degrees (at most [code]180.0[/code]; larger values are ignored). Angles above this are filtered out when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code], and map to a raw score of [code]1.0[/code] when scoring. If less than or equal to [member min_angle_degrees] on ready, adjusted to [code]min_angle_degrees + 1.0[/code].

Minimum signed angle in degrees (at least [code]-180.0[/code]; smaller values are ignored). Angles below this are filtered out when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code], and map to a raw score of [code]0.0[/code] when scoring.
